All targeted acceptance criteria pass: testimonial lightbox uses portrait ratio, backdrop is dark teal rgba(10,37,35,0.93), close/Escape work, player <=74vh with no horizontal overflow at 1920x800 and 390x844; hero player uses object-contain within its 4/5 card without overflow; 4 poster cards are equal height (364.5px desktop, 360.2px mobile) and align correctly; self-check result now shows track-specific education (anxiety/dependence/child) and a Phone CTA (09929300003, tel:+919929300003) with safe/confidential/judgment wording in EN and its Hinglish counterpart (surakshit, bina judgment) — with 0 Devanagari characters and no 'undefined'; provisional impression and not-a-diagnosis blocks still render for all 3 tracks; WA summary button opens https://wa.me/919929300003 with prefilled message, Google reviews href = https://www.google.com/maps?cid=11855348771608360738, retake resets to intro, and booking prefill flow (result-name-input, result-phone-input -> result-book-consultation-btn) populates book-name-input=R. Sharma, book-phone-input=9876543210, book-concern-select='Anxiety / Depression', shows book-prefill-note, submits successfully and displays book-thanks. Top banner and footer render correctly at both breakpoints with the new address, 09929300003 and 4:00 PM – 8:00 PM.
critical_code_review_comments: VideoTestimonials Lightbox uses aspect-ratio from onLoadedMetadata with a default 9/16 fallback — this is correct for portrait-only sources, but if a truly landscape source is later added and metadata takes >1 tick, users would briefly see a portrait letterbox before it settles. Consider setting preload='metadata' on the <video> so the ratio state resolves immediately.

Hero.jsx keeps aspect-[4/5] container even after switching to actual video — since the video uses object-contain, portrait videos taller than 4:5 will letterbox top/bottom inside the card. Acceptable as designed (frame-fixed card), but note this is by design, not a bug.

Headless Chromium could not fetch customer-assets video metadata during automated runs, so intrinsic vs rendered aspect equality could not be measured programmatically — verification here is by element geometry (74vh cap, no horizontal overflow, correct aspectRatio style application). Recommend main agent verify visually or via a lightweight HEAD/HLS probe.

Note: headless Chromium returns videoWidth=videoHeight=0 for customer-assets URLs, so intrinsic-vs-rendered aspect assertion is a soft check — verified indirectly via aspectRatio style value (0.5625/1) and no overflow.
rca of the issue: n/a — this was a fix verification run; the previous letterbox issue is mitigated by dynamic aspect-ratio inline style + max-h-[74vh] + w-auto in the Lightbox, and by object-contain on the hero video.
